caption:
OpenAI's GPT-6 launch did not go as planned, and the footage shows exactly where things slipped.

GPT-6 is OpenAI's most powerful model to date, built to handle harder reasoning tasks and longer, more complex conversations than anything they have put out before. The live launch, though, took a turn that had viewers replaying the clip. Not for the capabilities on display. For the moment the rollout visibly went off script.

Even the biggest AI company in the world is still run by people under pressure, and sometimes the camera catches it.
